en: Color image showing a grass airfield with several gliders and people in summer clothing preparing for flight. The gliders have registration numbers beginning with "DM-" and are parked on a large meadow. In the background there is a forested hillside dotted with villas, a tall slender TV tower on the ridge, and a distinctive steel truss cantilever bridge over a river to the right, under a blue sky with scattered clouds.
